label: Bible Study
prompt: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by _____ alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verse: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
note: Jesus answers the tempter by quoting Deuteronomy — after forty days of fasting, no less.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the _____ of the Almighty.
verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
note: The 'secret place' psalm — dwell close enough to the Almighty and you end up living in His shade.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in _____ clothes, lying in a manger.
verse: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
note: The angel's sign for the shepherds: a newborn in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

label: Deep Water
prompt: A double minded man is _____ in all his ways.
verse: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
note: James's doubter is tossed like a wave — 'double minded' is literally 'two-souled' in the Greek.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD turned the _____ of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verse: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
note: Job's turnaround came 'when he prayed for his friends' — the same friends who'd spent chapters lecturing him.
